inputs.text:
Let's be completely clear about what this exposes regarding the unchecked greed of the ruling elite and the ongoing betrayal of our working class. On Tuesday, 24 March 2026, during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition, new details laid bare in Parliament directly linked South African actress Terry Pheto to the staggering R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe. 

This is no isolated incident; it is a glaring symptom of deep-seated systemic corruption and structural inequality where institutional power is weaponized to siphon resources desperately needed by marginalized communities for public upliftment and labor-class survival. While vulnerable groups are left to bear the brunt of economic deprivation, the privileged few line their pockets by exploiting public entities like the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). This is why we need radical institutional reform and genuine accountability to dismantle these corrupt networks once and for all.
